messages.subject: Project Yarrow — qualification (SOW1) and FAI schedule
messages.plaintextBody:
Hannah,

Update on SOW1: manufacturing readiness review and process qualification are complete (M1, M2 signed off). The qualification ship-set is in build and we're tracking First Article Inspection acceptance for 30 January. We'll issue the FAI report per AS9102 with the C-scan and dimensional packs.

Can your team confirm availability for source inspection at Filton in the week of 26 January?

Priya
